name: Dad's Sausage Balls
author: Justin Crawley
steps: Shred sharp cheddar into microwave safe bowl
Add in the package of cream cheese
Melt together in microwave, stirring frequently until mostly melted
Slowly add bisquick a cup at a time
Add up to 1/4 cup milk as needed for consistency
Mix in sausage thoroughly until solid consistency
Roll mixture into ping pong ball size and place on ungreased baking sheet
Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes until golden brown
